responsibility: This source file contains checking-mode unit tests for GCC’s GTY and garbage-collection infrastructure. It defines representative GTY-annotated roots and object graphs to verify root marking, variable-length fields, tagged unions and desc expressions, destructor finalization, deletable globals, inheritance, chain_next traversal, user-supplied gt_ggc_mx/gt_pch_nx hooks, and basic tree marking, while also supplying dummy root tables for unchecked builds.
